versions.subject: Suspicious Control Panel DLL Load
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage: '*\System32\control.exe'
    CommandLine: '*\rundll32.exe *'
filter:
    CommandLine: '*Shell32.dll*'
condition: selection and not filter
